explanationMd: Write 16 as 2⁴. Equal powers of base 2 have equal exponents, so x + 1 = 4 and x = 3. Substitution gives 2^(3+1) = 16, confirming the result.

distractorRationale.a: This ignores the +1 in the exponent.
distractorRationale.b: This treats the exponent as multiplication.
distractorRationale.d: This divides the right-hand side by two instead of comparing powers.
